replies.text:
carbonated_user Did the phone attempt an auto update since it thought it was charging

Only if these settings were both set to ON:

Settings > System > System updates > Require device to be charging

Settings > System > System updates > Automatic reboot

'Require device to be charging' is by default OFF

'Automatic reboot' is by default ON

So, the default behaviour is automatic updating and rebooting regardless of whether the device is currently charging or not. As long as the battery is above 'warning level', which is very low (15% if I remember correctly)
